summaryZh: Vazquez-Mena 研究组把石墨烯等二维材料与其他纳米结构整合，研究用于光电、生物传感和三维结构的新型混合材料。实验室还使用半导体技术，探索工作频率高于1 MHz的声学超材料。
researchQuestions: 如何整合二维材料与纳米结构，获得新的光电及生物传感功能？
如何将声学超材料的工作频率提高到1 MHz以上？
topics: 二维材料与纳米结构整合

evidence.quote: Prof. Oscar Vazquez-Mena Research, Latest Publications and News
Professor Oscar Vazquez Mena’s research focuses on integration and application of nanoscale nanomaterials like graphene for energy harvesting, biological applications and flexible technologies.
His research also looks into developing two-dimensional hybrid metamaterials with novel functionalities for flexible devices.

Our research group focuses on the integration and application of 2-D materials like graphene and other nanoscale structures for applications in optoelectronics, biosensing, biology and 3-D architectures.

Our research aims to develop hybrid metamaterials, 2-D materials and 3-D architectures integrating different nanomaterials with novel functionalities and capabilities for applications in optoelectronics, light harvesting, biosensing, bioengineering and biomedical devices.
In our lab we are using the large toolbox of semiconductor technology to push the operation of acoustic metamaterials well above the 1 MHz range.
